original.target_description: Experiment 3: compliance with the zoo-trip request, rejection-moderation condition versus the combined equivalent request and smaller request only controls; second planned orthogonal comparison.

n.sample_role: Participants contributing the critical compliance comparison. Three mutually exclusive conditions, 24 participants each; controls pooled for the contrast.
n.exclusions: No exclusions from the Table 3 condition counts are reported; eight initial-request compliers in the equivalent request control remain in its 24-person final group.

notes: Identity assessment: supplied canonical text is a complete-looking 10-page primary journal article, with title Reciprocal Concessions Procedure for Inducing Compliance: The Door-in-the-Face Technique, the six matching authors, and Journal of Personality and Social Psychology, 1975, Vol. 31, No. 2, 206-215. DOI is not printed in the supplied text, so DOI identity was not independently confirmed. No PDF was supplied; canonical text only. Targets identified from Experiment 3 and the named contrasts, not row order or numerical matching. Replication and reported_success are unassigned placeholders. Analytic N derived from explicit randomized condition counts: 24 + 24 + 24 = 72. Three mutually exclusive conditions, 24 participants each; controls pooled for the contrast. No N was inferred from degrees of freedom. Canonical OCR renders chi-square as x2; printed statistic 2.88 and exact p = .091 belong to the same combined-control contrast.
